title: Typed synthesis API: synthesize, Voice, SpeechOptions, Speech, request_key
description: New `auritus/speech.py`, exported from `auritus`. It wraps `TTSBackend.generate` and derives segments from `breaks.py`. Adds a deterministic `fake` backend for specs. Specs: the story's scenarios on synthesis and the request key.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Implemented on branch `feature/auritus-70d43b-typed-speech-api`.
- New `auritus.speech` (re-exported from `auritus`): `Voice.parse`, `SpeechOptions(speed, seed)`, `synthesize` returning `Speech` (wav, sample_rate, duration, segments, provenance, request_key), and `request_key`.
- `synthesize` speaks each break block separately and joins them with the standard 0.75 s silence, so segment timings are exact. Voice markers still switch voice per block.
- `TTSBackend` gains `supports_speed` and `model_id()`. Kokoro honours speed (MLX and torch) and reports its real model repo. A backend that can't do speed raises `UnsupportedOption` instead of ignoring it.
- A deterministic `fake` backend (named explicitly, never a fallback) makes specs possible without models.
- `lang` was left out of SpeechOptions: no backend can honour it yet.
- Spec `features/speech_library.feature`: 5 scenarios, green. pytest: 93 passed. black and ruff clean.
- Real smoke test on Apple Silicon: kokoro:af_heart produced 24 kHz audio in 2 segments (0–1.80 s, 2.55–4.28 s), with provenance model mlx-community/Kokoro-82M-bf16.
